metadata.name: EchoSentinel Comprehensive Scam Phrase & Intent Ruleset
metadata.description: Structured, explainable heuristic scam intent patterns across English, Hinglish, and Hindi (Devanagari).

safety_rules.phrase: Never share your OTP with anyone.
A bank employee should never ask for your UPI PIN.
Scammers sometimes threaten to block accounts.
If you suspect fraud, contact your bank using its official number.
I received a suspicious call asking for my OTP.
The customer asked whether their KYC was complete.
Please verify this transaction through your bank's official app.
Our support team will never ask for your password.
Do not install remote-access applications at a caller's request.
I am explaining how UPI scams work.
The bank has sent an official notification about KYC.
I will never ask you to transfer money to my personal account.
Apna OTP kisi ke saath share mat karna.
Bank kabhi aapse secret PIN nahi maangta.

rules.phrase: You are under digital arrest.
Please tell me the OTP you received.
Apne mobile par aaya hua OTP bataiye.
Share the six-digit verification code.
I need your OTP to verify your identity.
Read out the code you just received.
Tell me the code to complete your KYC.
rules.notes: KYC completion pretext for credential disclosure

rules.phrase: Please forward the verification message to me.
Give me the OTP so I can unblock your account.
rules.notes: Account unblock pretext for OTP theft

rules.phrase: Your transaction will fail unless you share the code.
I am sending another OTP; tell me that one too.
Enter your UPI PIN to receive the money.
rules.notes: Classic UPI reverse collect fraud (PIN only needed to send money)

rules.phrase: You must enter your PIN to receive this refund.
rules.notes: PIN entry required for refund fraud

rules.phrase: Approve the UPI request I just sent you.
Scan this QR code to receive your payment.
rules.notes: QR code scanning fraud (scanning pays, never receives)

rules.phrase: Send me your UPI PIN for verification.
Transfer one rupee to verify your bank account.

Accept the collect request to receive your reward.

Approve the transaction before the offer expires.
Paise receive karne ke liye UPI PIN daalo.
Payment verify karne ke liye mere account mein paise bhejo.

Paise release karne ke liye pehle ek chhota charge pay karo.

Your account will be suspended within two hours.

rules.phrase: Aapka account do ghante mein suspend ho jayega.
